name: Guangzhou Development Group Incorporated
summary: Guangzhou Development Group Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy business in China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Coal-Fired Power Generation and Heating; Natural Gas Power and Heat; New Energy and Energy Storage; Gas; Energy Logistics; and Others. It is involved in the development, investment, construction, and operation management of energy projects; new energy power generation, energy storage, and electricity sale and services; and upstream gas source investment and procurement, midstream transportation and receiving, and downstream distribution and sales, as well as urban gas pipeline construction.
